name: Can I stay in my home during interior painting?
description: You can usually stay, especially for smaller projects, but avoid immediate work areas due to fumes. For larger jobs, temporary relocation might be considered.

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, you can remain in your home during interior painting, especially if only a few rooms are being painted at a time. However, it's advisable to avoid the immediate work areas due to paint fumes and active work. For extensive projects involving multiple rooms or strong-smelling paints, temporary relocation might be more comfortable. Hometelligent Inc. discusses potential disruptions and ventilation strategies with you upfront, helping you decide the best approach for your comfort and safety.
